created_prompt: Create a three year plan to grow my online cookery business and publish a cook book expanding on my video content which is focused on quick, healthy recipes. I currently have 1.2 million followers and am keen to expand rapidly. Limitations are time and budget. I work 4 days a week so please base the 3 year plan on this level of commitment. Plan should be realistic and achievable. Give me concrete steps I can do to reach my goal in the time frame. Please plan it on a monthly basis with action points each month.
